lines.text: Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee, sat on a mountain, and healed the lame, blind, crippled, and mute laid at His feet.
The crowd was amazed to see the mute speaking and the blind seeing, and they glorified the God of Israel.
Jesus had compassion on the crowd who had been with Him five days, and the disciples had seven loaves and a few small fish.
Jesus told the crowd to sit, gave thanks for the loaves and fish, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of leftovers.
Four thousand men were fed, besides women and children, and Jesus dismissed the crowds and went by boat to Magadan.
